decision.reason: The bound caller/root revisions freeze their own source content, not the revision identity of dynamically transcluded descendants. Treating a caller timestamp as a child-version selector would manufacture historical provenance.
decision.required_binding_method: Bind the dependency only from an explicit exact revision identity observed or deliberately selected in a controlled replay snapshot; record the observation context and never backdate the child identity from either caller/root timestamp.

evidence.observation: Normal template calls are dynamic transclusions: the template content is substituted when the caller is loaded, and later template edits affect pages that transclude it.
evidence.title: Help:Templates

evidence.observation: The revid parameter supplies revision context for REVISIONID and similar variables; it is not documented as a recursive template/module revision pin.
evidence.title: API:Expandtemplates

evidence.observation: MediaWiki does not provide normal versioned transclusion syntax for selecting an arbitrary specific template revision; T70399 was closed as a duplicate on 2026-08-14.
evidence.title: T31051 — No support for versioned transclusions (specific page/template revisions)

next_evidence_required: Capture or deliberately select an exact Модуль:String revision in a controlled replay observation, record title/revision/timestamp/MediaWiki SHA-1 plus observation context, then freeze its direct dependencies and continue recursively before any output or renderer promotion.
